newsitem.title: USA: VocalTec unveils Internet phone product.
newsitem.headline: VocalTec unveils Internet phone product.

text.p: Internet telephony company VocalTec Ltd on Tuesday unveiled technology that enables conference calls between callers using traditional phones and personal computer phones.

VocalTec's Atrium product works in conjunction with the VocalTec Telephony Gateway server software to bridge the public switching telephone network with the Internet, the company said in a press release.

Conference callers from traditional telephones participate as they would in a normal conference call while PC participants can engage in discussion and document collaboration using any Windows-based application, it said.
Participants on both ends of the call, whether from a PC or a reglar telephone, must use VocalTec's technology in order for the call to work.
Atrium consists of the new VocalTec Conference Server, the new VocalTec Forum Server, and the Internet Conference Professional software.
VocalTec says the full Atrium product will ship in June, with prices starting at about $2,400.
